evidenceBoundary: Playwright renders the built single-file Outreach Companion in the real sandboxed ExtensionHost. Deterministic local fixtures back Outreach storage, Mail inboxes and sends, model completion, catalog read, and toasts. Browser clipboard writeText is captured in the frame and exact text is asserted. This proves local UI state, retry, payloads, persistence, and reloadable host storage; it does not contact Core, a live model/provider, a real Mail transport, or an operating-system clipboard service. The Host fixture retains sandbox=allow-scripts without allow-forms, so the form's native requestSubmit/onSubmit event is not exercised; its Enter keydown validation and explicit submit button handler are covered.
